verdict.rationale: The evidence describes PayPal building infrastructure so that EXTERNAL AI assistants (ChatGPT, Gemini) and merchant-run agent frameworks can transact via PayPal, and an MCP server merchants can query with their own external MCP clients — this is the opposite of a built-in assistant embedded in the PayPal product that an end user delegates tasks to. No evidence shows a first-party AI assistant surfaced inside PayPal's own product/dashboard for users to delegate to.
